nominal.summary: Your brain and mood are in the healthy zone.
self_care: Maintain normal routines.
Take time to relax before sleep.
prevention: Talk to family and friends regularly.

watch.summary: You are showing early signs of fatigue or stress.
self_care: Try to get an extra hour of sleep tonight.
Reduce non-essential tasks.
watch.tell_crew: Let your commander know you are tired.
watch.contact_surgeon: Mention it during your next private medical conference.

warning.summary: DRAFT: Severe fatigue or stress is impacting your performance.
self_care: Stop complex tasks.
Take a mandatory rest period.
If on Surface rover, return to base safely.
warning.tell_crew: Tell the crew you need cover for your tasks.
warning.contact_surgeon: Contact the flight surgeon within 12 hours.

act.summary: Critical mental fatigue or severe mood distress.
self_care: Stand down from all operations immediately.
Use the approved crew medical kit procedure if advised.
If on Surface rover, abort mission and return to base immediately.
act.tell_crew: Inform commander you are medically unfit for duty today.

self_care: Keep up your daily exercise.

watch.summary: Your heart rate is slightly elevated.
self_care: Drink 500mL of water.
Rest for 15 minutes and measure again.
watch.tell_crew: No need unless you feel unwell.
watch.contact_surgeon: Mention it at your next routine check-in.

warning.summary: DRAFT: Heart metrics show strain or abnormal rhythms.
self_care: Stop physical labor.
Sit or lie down.
If on Surface rover, pause drive and prepare to return to base.
warning.tell_crew: Inform the crew you are experiencing heart strain.
warning.contact_surgeon: Contact the flight surgeon within 2 hours.

act.summary: Critical cardiovascular alert. Possible severe rhythm issue or chest pain.
self_care: Lie down immediately.
Use the approved crew medical kit procedure.
If on Surface rover, co-pilot must return to base immediately.
act.tell_crew: Declare a medical emergency to the crew.
prevention: Strict bed rest until cleared by surgeon.

nominal.summary: Breathing and oxygen levels are normal.
self_care: Breathe normally.
prevention: Clean cabin air filters on schedule.

watch.summary: Slight decrease in oxygen or increase in breathing rate.
self_care: Check cabin CO2 levels.
Take slow, deep breaths.
watch.tell_crew: Ask if others feel short of breath.
watch.contact_surgeon: Mention it at the next check-in.
prevention: Ensure good ventilation in your sleeping quarters.

warning.summary: DRAFT: Oxygen is low or breathing is difficult.
self_care: Move to a well-ventilated module.
Rest quietly.
If on Surface rover, check suit scrubbers and return to base.
warning.tell_crew: Tell the crew you are having trouble breathing.

self_care: Call the crew medical officer immediately and follow approved medical/atmosphere procedures.
Use the approved crew medical kit procedure.
If on Surface rover, initiate emergency return to base.

nominal.summary: No signs of illness or infection.
self_care: Maintain good hygiene.

watch.summary: Mild symptoms like a scratchy throat or slight temperature rise.
self_care: Drink hot fluids.
Get extra sleep.
watch.tell_crew: Warn crew you might be catching a cold.
prevention: Wear a mask in shared spaces.

warning.summary: DRAFT: Clear signs of infection, such as fever or rash.
self_care: Isolate in your quarters if possible.
Rest completely.
If on Surface rover, return to base to avoid spreading illness.
warning.tell_crew: Inform crew so they can take precautions.

act.summary: Severe infection with high fever or severe pain.
self_care: Strict isolation.
Use the approved crew medical kit procedure.
If on Surface rover, abort and return to base immediately.

nominal.summary: Energy levels and body mass are stable.
self_care: Eat all your scheduled meals.

watch.summary: Slight weight loss or missing meals.
self_care: Eat a high-calorie snack.
Force yourself to finish your meals.
prevention: Schedule meals with the crew to encourage eating.

warning.summary: DRAFT: Significant weight loss or low blood sugar.
self_care: Consume quick sugars if dizzy.
Increase daily calorie intake by 20%.
If on Surface rover, ensure you eat before driving and return to base if dizzy.

act.summary: Dangerous weight loss or severe metabolic crash.
self_care: Stop all work.
Use the approved crew medical kit procedure.
If on Surface rover, co-pilot must return rover to base.

nominal.summary: Muscle strength and mass are maintained.
self_care: Complete today's exercise protocol.

watch.summary: Muscle soreness or skipped exercise days.
self_care: Stretch carefully.
Ensure you complete tomorrow's workout.
watch.contact_surgeon: Mention it if soreness lasts more than 2 days.

warning.summary: DRAFT: Noticeable weakness, joint pain, or missed multiple workouts.
self_care: Modify workouts to avoid pain.
Apply heat or cold to painful joints.
If on Surface rover, avoid heavy lifting during EVA and return to base.
warning.tell_crew: Tell crew you cannot assist with heavy manual tasks.
prevention: Review exercise form with experts on the ground.

act.summary: Severe pain, suspected injury, or extreme weakness.
self_care: Immobilize the painful area.
Use the approved crew medical kit procedure.
If on Surface rover, abort EVA and return to base immediately.
act.tell_crew: Declare an injury to the commander.
prevention: No physical work until cleared by surgeon.

nominal.summary: Radiation exposure is well within safe limits.
self_care: Keep dosimeter on you.
prevention: Stay out of low-shielding areas during solar events.

watch.summary: Slightly elevated exposure reading or minor solar event warning.
self_care: Move away from exterior walls when sleeping.
prevention: Maximize time in heavily shielded modules.

warning.summary: DRAFT: High radiation exposure detected or major solar storm warning.
self_care: Move to the radiation shelter immediately.
If on Surface rover, seek terrain shielding or return to base at maximum safe speed.
warning.contact_surgeon: Contact mission control and surgeon ASAP.
prevention: Do not leave the shelter until all-clear is given.

self_care: Remain in maximum shielding.
Use the approved crew medical kit procedure to treat nausea.
If on Surface rover, this is a life-threatening emergency; return to base immediately if driving is possible.
